description: Add an invisible text layer to a scanned PDF so it can be searched and copied (Tesseract, English, German, Bulgarian). First 5 pages per call. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.01/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/pdf-ocr.

fileContent.description: The file as base64 (a data: URI is fine)

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.pdf
